_doc: Publication policy for `exo publish` (ADR-0005), for the SYNTHETIC fixture
instance. Fail-closed: anything not listed here is not published, and its
appearance FAILS the build rather than defaulting to serve.
Values: 'serve' = copied to zones/_serve/ and reachable by a remote read
Held note folders propagate: their atoms and both vector tables are removed
too, because t2_atom carries note text verbatim. This fixture deliberately
contains something in every held category, so the guard has real work to do.

zone_notes.t0_chat: Declared, but this fixture never runs `exo chatindex`, so the zone is not built and publish skips it with a message. Kept here on purpose: a declared-but-unbuilt zone is a state the engine has to survive, and the fixture should exercise it.
zone_notes.rows: Cross-zone union — would bypass every per-zone decision in this file.
zone_notes.cache_embed: The content-addressed vector cache. Machine output about machine output; no reader.
zone_notes.cache_open_questions: A view over t1_open_thread under legacy column names. The canonical zone already serves; publishing both would ship the same questions twice.
zone_notes.t1_post: The one zone where serve is not a judgement: every row is already published at example.com, and each carries its live URL so an answer can link rather than paraphrase.
zone_notes.t1_project_doc: README / CONTEXT / ADR prose from the workshop snapshot. Prose and metadata only — no source code is captured at any layer.
zone_notes.t2_affinity: Published without `score`: that column blends plays with note mentions using a weight, and the read surface ranks by relevance, never by preference.

folder_notes.Journaling: The daily entries. First-person, unfinished, and the reason the folder axis exists.
folder_notes: Unfiled, including notes promoted out of conversation. No decision means held.

path_zone_notes._axis: Gradient position, independent of note_folders. A note publishes only if BOTH axes say serve.
path_zone_notes.refined/unshared: Private prose that was worked on but never shared. Never leaves.
path_zone_notes.raw/chat-promoted: Verbatim spans promoted out of a conversation. Held until deliberately widened.
path_zone_notes.raw/daily: Freeform per-day capture; the same character as the held Journaling folder.
path_zone_notes.refined/shared: Essays that also exist on the blog, so serving them exposes nothing new.

chat_topics._doc: t0_chat_topic and t0_chat are windowed together, and titles named here never leave.
chat_topics._window_doc: A conversation older than this is not published. The window is applied to both chat tables, not just the topic list.
hold_titles: Working out why I keep putting off the same message
chat_topics._hold_doc: Titles leak on their own. This one names a private matter, so the topic row and every turn under it are absent from the projection rather than merely unreturned.

sensitive_rows._doc: Row-level decisions inside an otherwise-served zone. This fixture has none; the key is kept so the shape is visible.
